title: Website Terms and Conditions | Miller Remodeling Idaho
description: Terms for using the Miller Remodeling website and submitting project inquiries in Idaho.
heading: Website terms and conditions
intro: These terms apply to your use of the Miller Remodeling website.

sections.heading: Website information
paragraphs: Website content is general information about our services. Project scope, availability, timing, design deliverables, and pricing are discussed individually and confirmed in a written agreement when applicable.

sections.heading: Submitting an inquiry
paragraphs: Please provide accurate contact and project information and share only photos or material you have permission to provide. Sending an inquiry or booking a conversation does not by itself create a construction contract.

sections.heading: Using the site
paragraphs: Do not misuse the site, interfere with its operation, or submit unlawful or harmful content. Third-party services, including appointment scheduling, have their own terms and privacy practices.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For questions about these terms, call (208) 608-4439 or use the contact form.
